title: My Laundry Machine Kept Running at 3 AM (Final Part)
script: The girl on my camera looked exactly like me, and she told me not to open the dryer yet. I waited three days. Then I opened it. Inside, folded and warm, was everything I thought I'd lost this year. My keys. My mom's old scarf. The birthday card she sent before she passed. And one last sticky note, in my handwriting. It said: You stopped taking care of yourself after Mom. So I did it for you. I'm the part of you that remembers. I sat on that cold floor and cried for an hour. Now I do my laundry on Sunday afternoons. The machine never runs at 3 AM anymore. But every Sunday, there's a new note on my fridge. It just says: Proud of you. Follow for more stories.
description: The final part of the 3 AM laundry mystery. What was in the dryer? This is a fictional story.
